_comment: Default TouchTerrain processing parameters. Keys prefixed with _ are stripped before passing to TouchTerrain.
_tip_tilewidth: Width of each tile in mm. Match your printer's build plate.
_tip_ntilesx: Number of tiles in the X (longitude) direction. Increase for large areas.
_tip_ntilesy: Number of tiles in the Y (latitude) direction.
_tip_basethick: Thickness of the solid base in mm. Minimum 0.5. Thicker = stronger but heavier.
_tip_zscale: Vertical exaggeration. 1.0 = true scale. Override with --z-scale or Z_SCALE in .env.
_tip_printres: Horizontal resolution of the mesh in mm. Match your nozzle diameter (0.4mm is standard FDM).
_tip_fileformat: Output format. STLb = binary STL (compact). STLa = ASCII STL (human-readable but large).
_tip_tile_centered: If true, each tile is centered at 0,0 — correct for single-tile prints; lets slicers auto-place at bed centre. If false, tiles are offset for correct relative placement in multi-tile assemblies.
_tip_no_bottom: If true, omit the bottom face (saves filament for display models glued to a surface).
_tip_no_normals: If true, skip face normals in STL output. Most slicers recompute them anyway; skip for smaller files. Set false if your slicer reports non-manifold edges.
_tip_smooth_borders: Smooth the tile border edges. Recommended for multi-tile assemblies.
